stops.name: Brocken
stops.quote: The Brocken is the highest peak in the Harz Mountains at 1,141 metres.
stops.english: The Brocken is the highest peak in the Harz Mountains at 1,141 metres.

stops.name: Heinrich Heine Trail
stops.quote: Probably the most beautiful ascent to the Brocken starts in Ilsenburg and follows the footsteps of Heinrich Heine along the mountain stream Ilse.
stops.english: Probably the most beautiful ascent to the Brocken starts in Ilsenburg and follows the footsteps of Heinrich Heine along the mountain stream Ilse.

stops.name: Eckerloch
stops.quote: For experienced and well-equipped hikers, the charming ascent from Schierke through the Eckerloch to the Brocken is recommended.
stops.english: For experienced and well-equipped hikers, the charming ascent from Schierke through the Eckerloch to the Brocken is recommended.

stops.name: Devil’s Trail
stops.quote: The Devil’s Trail is the most difficult ascent to the Brocken.
stops.english: The Devil’s Trail is the most difficult ascent to the Brocken.

stops.name: Goethe Trail
stops.quote: Just as Goethe once started from Torfhaus in the west to climb the Brocken, this is probably the most popular hiking trail across the Great Torfhaus Moor to the Brocken.
stops.english: Just as Goethe once started from Torfhaus in the west to climb the Brocken, this is probably the most popular hiking trail across the Great Torfhaus Moor to the Brocken.

stops.name: Great Torfhaus Moor
stops.quote: Just as Goethe once started from Torfhaus in the west to climb the Brocken, this is probably the most popular hiking trail across the Great Torfhaus Moor to the Brocken.
stops.english: Just as Goethe once started from Torfhaus in the west to climb the Brocken, this is probably the most popular hiking trail across the Great Torfhaus Moor to the Brocken.

stops.name: Dreieckiger Pfahl
stops.quote: On this hiking trail, you reach the Brocken via the Dreieckiger Pfahl and the Harz Border Trail.
stops.english: On this hiking trail, you reach the Brocken via the Dreieckiger Pfahl and the Harz Border Trail.

stops.name: Harz Border Trail
stops.quote: On this hiking trail, you reach the Brocken via the Dreieckiger Pfahl and the Harz Border Trail.
stops.english: On this hiking trail, you reach the Brocken via the Dreieckiger Pfahl and the Harz Border Trail.

stops.name: Devil’s Pulpit
stops.quote: Take your time for the Brocken circular walk with the Devil’s Pulpit and Witch’s Altar.
stops.english: Take your time for the Brocken circular walk with the Devil’s Pulpit and Witch’s Altar.

stops.name: Witch’s Altar
stops.quote: Take your time for the Brocken circular walk with the Devil’s Pulpit and Witch’s Altar.
stops.english: Take your time for the Brocken circular walk with the Devil’s Pulpit and Witch’s Altar.

stops.name: Brockengarten
stops.quote: In the Brocken Garden, founded in 1890, around 1,800 alpine species from all over the world grow today.
stops.english: In the Brocken Garden, founded in 1890, around 1,800 alpine species from all over the world grow today.

stops.name: Brockenhaus
stops.quote: Inside, a modern and extensive exhibition on the history and nature of the Brocken summit awaits you.
stops.english: Inside, a modern and extensive exhibition on the history and nature of the Brocken summit awaits you.
